name: Urban Limit Reworked
short_description: Limited, geography-aware urbanization. Each province holds a limited number of towns and cities, growing with Global Trade, Manufactories and Industrialization; a city needs 5,000 burghers, and where they can grow now depends on climate, rivers, coasts and lakes, and the local resources: desert and tundra stay rural, fertile river valleys and rich trade goods support towns and cities.
